creative.describe.avatar: Describe this profile picture/avatar. Focus on the person's appearance, style, notable features, and any artistic elements. Make no mention about quality or resolution.
creative.describe.banner: Describe this profile banner image. Focus on the scene, colors, mood, and notable elements. Make no mention about quality or resolution.
creative.describe.photo: Describe this image. Make no mention about the quality, resolution, or pixelation.
creative.describe.general: Describe this image. Make no mention about the quality, resolution, or pixelation.
creative.image.editing-system-prompt: You are an image editor. The user has attached reference image(s). Use the attached image(s) as the direct basis for your output. Preserve the appearance, features, and identity of subjects in the reference image(s) as closely as possible. Apply ONLY the specific changes described in the prompt. Do not re-imagine or reinvent the image from scratch.
creative.detect.instruction: Detect {{target}} in the image. Return ONLY a JSON array with no markdown fences and no prose. Each item must be: {"box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "label": "short descriptive label"} where coordinates are integers normalized to 0-1000. Return at most {{max}} items, most prominent first. If nothing matches, return [].
creative.detect.none-found: No matches found for "{{target}}" in the image.
creative.segment.instruction: Give the segmentation masks for {{subject}}. Output ONLY a JSON list of segmentation masks with no markdown fences and no prose. Each entry must contain the 2D bounding box in the key "box_2d" ([ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], integers normalized to 0-1000), the segmentation mask in key "mask" (base64 PNG), and the text label in the key "label". Use descriptive labels.
creative.segment.none-found: Could not segment "{{subject}}" in the image. The subject may be unclear, too small, or absent — try a more specific subject description.
creative.segment.result-success: Background removed. The delivered PNG keeps the original pixels of: {{labels}} — everything else is transparent.
creative.image.reference-manifest-header: REFERENCE IMAGE IDENTITIES — the attached reference images appear in this exact order. When the prompt names a person or subject listed here, base that subject's appearance ONLY on their own listed reference image. Never attach a listed name to a different reference's likeness. Prompt names with no listed reference have no likeness constraint.
creative.image.greenscreen-directive: CRITICAL BACKGROUND REQUIREMENT: Place the subject on a completely solid, uniform, pure chromakey green background (#00FF00). The background must be one single flat green color across the entire image — no gradients, shadows, reflections, vignettes, textures, or lighting effects on it. The subject itself must not contain green colors. Give the subject sharp, clean, well-defined edges.
creative.image.result-transparent: The background was removed — the delivered image is a PNG with real alpha transparency.
creative.image.transparent-failed: Note: a transparent background was requested, but the background could not be reliably keyed out; the image was delivered with its original background.
creative.image.safety-block-error: Image generation was blocked by content safety filters after {{attemptCount}} attempts (including softened prompts). The content may be too explicit to generate even with creative alternatives.
creative.image.no-image-error: No image was generated. The model may have returned text instead. Try a more specific and descriptive prompt.
creative.image.result-softened: Image generated and delivered to the user. Note: the original prompt was automatically softened to comply with content safety filters (e.g., nudity replaced with robes/clothing, violence with calmer alternatives). The image captures the spirit of the request with a more tasteful interpretation. Now write your chat reply about the image — plain prose only, no URLs, tags, or image listings (the user already sees it).
creative.image.result-success: Image generated and delivered to the user. Now write your chat reply about the image — plain prose only, no URLs, tags, or image listings (the user already sees it).
creative.audio.result-success: Audio generated and delivered to the user.
creative.audio.result-local-tts: Audio generated and delivered to the user (local espeak-ng TTS).
tool-search.action-nudge-disabled: IMPORTANT: Some discovered tools are NOT currently enabled (isEnabled: false). You MUST call enable_tools with the tool names you need before you can use them. After enabling, the tools become available on your next iteration.
tool-search.action-nudge-enabled: All matched tools are already enabled — you can call them directly.
file.replace-no-match: No match found for 'oldString'. The exact string was not found in the file. Ensure whitespace and indentation match exactly.
file.patch-context-mismatch: Patch could not be applied — the file content does not match the diff context. Ensure the patch was generated against the current file version.
lsp.implementations-label: Find concrete implementations of an interface or abstract class
lsp.server-not-installed-hint: The language server may not be installed. Check that npx can find the server binary.
lsp.no-results-hint: No results found — the symbol may be external, unresolvable, or the server hasn't finished indexing. Try again in a few seconds.
compute.cron-hint: Standard cron: minute(0-59) hour(0-23) day(1-31) month(1-12) weekday(0-6, 0=Sun)
